metadata.title: Ashtami MAHABHOG (Non Veg Spl Prasad) in Chatterjee Bonedi Bari Durga Puja Kolkata I Anjali,Dhunuchi
metadata.description:
On the eve of Maha Ashtami, we had the privilege of partaking a gratifying non-vegetarian bhog at the historic 164-year-old bonedi Durga Puja of Chorbagan Chatterjee Bari. 

Discovering the background behind the non-vegetarian bhog tradition alongside our host Pritha @sunandshower was an eye-opening experience as it reshaped our usual perception of bhog being solely vegetarian.

Today's episode offers a captivating journey through significant rituals of the day like Maha Ashtami Puspanjali and Sandhi Pujo along with the mesmerizing Dhunuchi Naach tradition. 

Join us as we immerse ourselves in deep-rooted faith, festive exuberance and spectacular celebrations of this auspicious day. 

#dfwinkolkata 
#kolkatadurgapuja
#mahaashtami
